title: InstantiateMsg
description: Instantiate the dao-proposal-wavs contract. Called by the DAO core during `voting_module_instantiate_info` or `proposal_modules_instantiate_info` setup.

authorized_service.description: The authorized WAVS service identity. v1 supports `SingleOperator`.

auto_execute.description: Whether to auto-execute on attestation accept (subject to timelock if veto is configured).

service_manager.description: The WAVS service-manager contract address to defer envelope validation to.

veto.description: Optional veto + timelock configuration. Same shape as dao-proposal-single.

Addr.description:
A human readable address.

In Cosmos, this is typically bech32 encoded. But for multi-chain smart contracts no assumptions should be made other than being UTF-8 encoded and of reasonable length.

This type represents a validated address. It can be created in the following ways 1. Use `Addr::unchecked(input)` 2. Use `let checked: Addr = deps.api.addr_validate(input)?` 3. Use `let checked: Addr = deps.api.addr_humanize(canonical_addr)?` 4. Deserialize from JSON. This must only be done from JSON that was validated before such as a contract's state. `Addr` must not be used in messages sent by the user because this would result in unvalidated instances.

This type is immutable. If you really need to mutate it (Really? Are you sure?), create a mutable copy using `let mut mutable = Addr::to_string()` and operate on that `String` instance.

AuthorizedService.description: Authorized WAVS service. v1 supports a single-operator gate; quorum + registry come in v2.

oneOf.description: A single WAVS operator address is the only one allowed to submit attested envelopes.
k-of-n operator quorum. (v2 — not handled in v0.1 verify path.)
Indirection through an external registry contract. (v2.)

Duration.description: Duration is a delta of time. You can add it to a BlockInfo or Expiration to move that further in the future. Note that an height-based Duration and a time-based Expiration cannot be combined

MandateFilterConfig.description: Configuration for the cw-filter mandate gate.

filter.description: The JSON filter spec passed to `Filter { filter, msg }`.

early_execute.description: Whether or not the vetoer can execute a proposal early before the timelock duration has expired

timelock_duration.description: The time duration to lock a proposal for after its expiration to allow the vetoer to veto.

veto_before_passed.description: Whether or not the vetoer can veto a proposal before it passes.

vetoer.description: The address able to veto proposals.
